description.value: The BC Parliament Buildings are Victoria's most iconic landmark, housing the Legislative Assembly of British Columbia on the Inner Harbour since 1898. Touring cyclists arriving in the city will find public tours of the ornate Romanesque Revival chambers, a gift shop, and an on-site dining room. The buildings sit at the heart of Victoria's tourist core, making them a natural waypoint on any tour of the city.
